title: Sandwich And Knifes
description: The Neoforge Mod Adds Sandwich And Knifes Cheeze And more...
body:
🧀 Simple Survival Additions

This mod adds small but useful survival items to make early-game Minecraft more fun and practical.

🔪 New Weapons

Iron Knife

Diamond Knife
Crafted using a half plank + ingots/diamonds
Knives are faster than swords and great for quick combat or utility builds.

🧀 New Food Item: Cheese

Smelt a milk bucket in a furnace to get Cheese

A simple, fun way to turn milk into actual food

🥪 New Craftable: Sandwich

2 Bread + 1 Cheese

Easy early-game food source

Perfect for quick hunger refill while mining or exploring

⚙️ Why Download?

Adds simple, vanilla-style content

Lightweight & survival-friendly

Perfect for small modpacks

Makes milk actually useful

Adds early-game weapon variety

No crazy tech. No 200-item recipe book. Just clean survival upgrades.
